project.name: memory-game
project.description: Static browser memory game with a Project-owned HTML, CSS, and JavaScript implementation.

notes: This adoption adds the KiNoTch Base and Project Overlay without moving the existing browser files.
The static game implementation remains Project-owned.
Project-owned behavior verification uses Node built-ins only and exercises existing browser interaction/state paths with a minimal DOM harness.
Behavior verification explicitly runs from the repository root so root-owned browser modules are loaded through their real relative import paths.
Ruby rendering verification checks imported markup escaping while preserving controlled ruby output.
